title: FrontierX
description: Expand the world border by completing advancements. Start in a tiny world and unlock more land as your players progress.
body:
FrontierX

FrontierX is a progression-based world border plugin for Paper servers.

Players begin inside a tiny world border and must complete advancements to expand their playable area.

Every advancement contributes toward unlocking more space, creating a unique survival challenge where exploration, resource gathering, and progression are tightly connected.

Features

- Advancement-based border growth
- Configurable starting border size
- Configurable growth requirements
- BossBar progress display
- Automatic border persistence
- Progress tracking
- Admin controls
- Lightweight and optimized
- Paper 1.21+ support

Commands

Player Commands

- "/fx help"
- "/fx size"
- "/fx progress"

Admin Commands

- "/fx pause"
- "/fx resume"
- "/fx reload"
- "/fx set <size>"
- "/fx add <size>"
- "/fx shrink <size>"
- "/fx reset"
- "/fx debug"

Permissions

- "frontierx.admin"

Configuration

border:
  size: 5

growth:
  task: 1
  goal: 3
  challenge: 10

messages:
  enabled: true

Recommended Use

FrontierX is designed for SMPs, challenge worlds, hardcore survival servers, and advancement-based progression gameplay.

Start small. Expand through achievement.

Good luck surviving the frontier.
